title: Enterprise agent startup LaunchDeck raises $40M to automate customer support workflows
summary: LaunchDeck's agent platform handles tier-1 support tickets end to end, with human review queues and per-step audit logs.

title: Report: 63% of enterprises now pilot AI agents in production
summary: A survey of 800 companies finds agent pilots concentrated in support, data entry and internal IT, while governance remains the top blocker.

title: EU lawmakers draft liability rules for autonomous AI agents
summary: The draft assigns liability to deployers when agents transact without explicit user confirmation; industry groups push back.

title: Open-weights multimodal model Aurora-24B released under Apache 2.0
summary: The 24B vision-language model matches closed competitors on document understanding benchmarks and ships with an inference recipe for consumer GPUs.

title: Chipmaker VoltAI unveils next-gen AI accelerator with 2x memory bandwidth
summary: The HBM4-based accelerator targets inference workloads and claims 40% better energy efficiency than its predecessor.
